evaluation.probabilities: float32; mean single-draw and ensemble kept separate

analysis.primary: resampled-minus-fixed fixed-inference accuracy; one primary hypothesis
analysis.secondary: real-minus-identity-adjacency; one separately declared secondary hypothesis
analysis.uncertainty: same balanced random-intercept moments and subject-df t as original protocol
analysis.selection_note: HGD selected after known original effect. Architecture fixed after T-only 30-epoch pilot; negative/small schedule effects will be reported.

architecture.node_features: eight 125-sample log population-variance windows per channel, clamp 1e-8; existing 8-30Hz EEG
architecture.graph_operator: D^-1/2 (A+I) D^-1/2; upper PLV weights reconstructed symmetrically before normalization
architecture.normalization: LayerNorm per node hidden vector; no auxiliary coordinate BN
architecture.readout: flatten fixed channel ordering then linear classifier
architecture.scope: HGD-only extension. Changes representation and graph computation together, not pure causal architecture manipulation.
